methods.name: TECV: Tweedie-Calibrated Expectation-Propagation Composed Velocity
methods.one_liner: Replace the frozen velocity's implicit posterior mean with the closed-form mean of (policy posterior x analytic safety truncations x Gaussian destination factor), using the policy's OWN posterior covariance measured by one JVP per constraint direction — a self-calibrated, marginal-correct tilted velocity with zero tunable guidance gain.
methods.gap_it_fills: Theory G3 (exact composition of a frozen velocity field with a NON-generative analytic expert) and G1 (a distributional statement about what the steered deterministic few-step sampler actually samples, with named bias sources), plus GAP 1 (safety and task tilts composed inside the same velocity evaluation, not sequentially) and GAP 6 (guidance provably vanishes when the policy is confident-and-compliant). Also replaces our hand-tuned denoising-time schedule: guidance authority decays automatically with the measured posterior covariance, answering G1's 'derive the schedule' ask.
methods.math: pi0.5 interpolant: x_tau = tau*A + (1-tau)*eps, eps~N(0,I), tau:0->1. Fact 1 (exact): v_theta(x,tau) ~ E[A-eps|x] implies v = (mu - x)/(1-tau) with mu(x,tau)=E[A|x_tau]; hence mu = x + (1-tau)v_theta (the x1 plug-in IS the posterior mean). Fact 2 (second-order Tweedie, exact for this linear-Gaussian channel): grad_x mu(x,tau) = (tau/(1-tau)^2) Cov[A|x_tau]. Therefore Sigma n = ((1-tau)^2/tau)(n + (1-tau) * JVP_{v_theta}(n)) — the policy's directional posterior covariance costs one jax.jvp. Fact 3 (tilt-exactness): for target terminal p_tilde(A) ∝ p(A) w(A), the tilted marginal path under the SAME interpolant starts at N(0,I) (x_0 independent of A) and its marginal-preserving velocity is v_tilde(x,tau) = (E_{p(a|x)}[a w(a)] / E_{p(a|x)}[w(a)] - x)/(1-tau). No scores are added, so the Reduce-Reuse-Recycle no-go (summed scores mis-sample products) does not apply: we compute the tilted posterior MEAN directly. Fact 4 (closed form): approximate p(a|x) ~ N(mu, Sigma) with Sigma measured along the r active directions (Fact 2; symmetrize n_i^T Sigma n_j from the same r JVPs). Take w(a) = prod_i 1[n_i^T a >= c_i] * exp(-||Pa-g||^2/(2 rho^2)) (linearized barrier faces at mu; destination factor on payload coordinates). Single half-space: exact truncated-Gaussian update mu* = mu + Sigma n * phi(z)/(Phi(z) sqrt(n^T Sigma n)), z = (n^T mu - c)/sqrt(n^T Sigma n), mass Z = Phi(z). Gaussian factor: exact product update. Multiple factors: 2-3 fixed EP sweeps (probit-EP, standard, jittable). Output velocity v* = (mu* - x)/(1-tau). Guarantee (idealized): if v_theta is the exact velocity, the local posterior is Gaussian, and constraints are the linearized factors, then continuous-time integration of v* samples EXACTLY p1(A) w(A)/Z. The three bias sources (network error, non-Gaussian posterior via third-cumulant Stein-type bound, Euler discretization shared with baseline) are named and separable. Vanishing: shift magnitude <= sqrt(n^T Sigma n) * lambda(z) -> 0 as Sigma -> 0 with h(mu)>0, i.e., guidance provably vanishes when the policy is confident and compliant; as tau->1, Sigma ~ (1-tau)^2/tau -> 0, so late-step authority decays automatically — the schedule is derived, not tuned.
methods.algorithm: Per Euler step k (tau_k >= ~0.1 to avoid the tau=0 singularity), per surviving seed: (1) forward v_theta(x_k, tau_k); mu_k = x_k + (1-tau_k) v_theta. (2) Decode endpoint prediction, evaluate barrier stack; collect active/near-active faces (h_i <= eps_act) -> unit normals n_i in action-chunk space (reuse the exact gradient rows our DCBF sweep already computes), plus the destination factor from the corridor/destination module. (3) r JVPs of v_theta at x_k along {n_i} -> Sigma n_i via Fact 2; clamp n_i^T Sigma n_i at a PSD floor; symmetrize cross terms. (4) Run 3 fixed EP sweeps over truncation + Gaussian factors -> tilted mean mu_k*, total feasibility mass Z_k. (5) If Z_k < Z_min: mark seed 'belief-infeasible' (honest trigger; contributes to fallback vote), else set v* = (mu_k* - x_k)/(1-tau_k). (6) Feed v* into the UNCHANGED per-step DCBF exact sweep (sweep stays last; hard certificate untouched). (7) Continue Euler. Best-of-K, brake-then-push, lexicographic certificate all unchanged downstream.
methods.joint_safety_task_story: Safety truncations and the task destination factor enter as factors of ONE product measure whose mean EP computes jointly — the tilted mean trades them off through the policy's own covariance geometry rather than applying safety as an override and task as an afterthought. Because the pre-sweep distribution is already tilted toward (safe AND progressing) actions, the hard sweep fires less and mangles less (lower FAR/AD), while task progress is shaped where authority is cheap (early steps, large Sigma) instead of being purchased by violating margins. Safety is never traded: the exact sweep remains the final operator, so the invariance theorem is untouched; TECV only changes what the sweep receives.
methods.why_novel: Closest neighbors, all distinct: (a) our claimed soft-hinge x1 pre-shaping — a fixed-gain heuristic shift; TECV has NO gain (magnitude fixed by measured Tweedie covariance and truncated-Gaussian moments), an exactness theorem, multi-factor EP, and a feasibility-mass certificate. (b) RMG 'Follow the Mean' (2605.10302) — convex mixing with reference banks, heuristic beta_t, no analytic factors, no measured covariance, no tilt-exactness. (c) Q-VGM (2606.08015) — uses the same one-Euler plug-in but with a TRAINED critic and fine-tunes the policy. (d) Uehara/Doob line and Feng et al. 2502.02150 — state the tilt identity abstractly but require posterior samples or trained values at noisy states; TECV is the first computable closed-form instantiation for analytic factors on a frozen policy, training-free and sampling-free. (e) SuperDiff/FKC — require both experts generative with density access and SDE sampling. (f) 'Are We Really Tilting' (2606.02884) — closed-form damping in Gaussian toy targets; TECV operationalizes the same within-mode correction on a real 3B policy via measured covariance. Nothing in the latest survey composes an analytic barrier stack with a frozen velocity field marginal-correctly, and no method self-calibrates guidance strength from the policy's Tweedie Jacobian.
methods.failure_modes: Multimodal local posterior breaks the Gaussian approximation: the EP mean can fall between modes (off-manifold). Mitigations: apply per seed from step >= 2-3 (each seed is already basin-committed mid-integration; Gaussianity is local), and detect mismatch between Tweedie covariance and cross-seed endpoint dispersion. Network approximation error corrupts the measured covariance (it is the policy's BELIEF, not truth) — clamp to PSD floor/ceiling; exactness claim degrades gracefully and honestly. Linearization of curved superquadric faces at mu is stale within a step — re-linearized every step. Does NOT do mode re-selection (2606.02884's second failure class) — explicitly out of scope; best-of-K and Method 3 own that. Adds r JVPs per step (r ~ 1-3 active faces): ~10-30 extra NFE-equivalents per chunk per surviving seed; if budget-bound, apply only in the mid-tau window where Sigma is largest.
methods.implementation_on_our_stack: Pure modification of the jitted velocity function; zero host calls. Changes: (1) sampler step fn: insert compute_mu -> gather active faces (reuse sweep's gradient rows) -> jax.jvp(v_theta, x, n_i) loop with fixed r_max and masking -> fixed-3-iteration EP (pure scalar ops on n_i^T Sigma n_j, Phi/phi via jax.scipy) -> v*. (2) sweep unchanged, runs after. (3) Seed-level Z_k accumulated into the existing certificate/fallback logic. All shapes static, fully jittable under the existing scan. New config: eps_act, Z_min, PSD floor, r_max. The destination factor reuses the corridor/destination-margin module's target g.
methods.cost_days: 4-6 days: 1 day Tweedie-JVP covariance + unit tests against finite differences; 1-2 days EP module + truncated-Gaussian moment tests; 1 day sampler integration; 1-2 days SafeLIBERO ablation (TECV on/off at matched CAR).
methods.expected_gain: Lower FAR and AD (distribution pre-tilted, sweep fires less), higher TSR at matched CAR on conditions where hard repair currently mangles chunks (repair-heavy Long/L2 cells); removes schedule hyperparameter sensitivity (one fewer tuned knob, better cross-condition robustness). Paper-level: first marginal-correct frozen-policy x analytic-expert composition with a vanishing-guidance guarantee.

methods.name: APNR: Adjoint-Priced Nullspace Restitution
methods.one_liner: Price the task damage done by each Euler step's safety repair with task co-states propagated backward through the sampler's own Jacobian (one lean-adjoint pass, ~10 VJPs), then restore AT MOST that much task progress in the nullspace of the active barrier gradients — repair becomes task-neutral to first order, with the hard certificate untouched.
methods.gap_it_fills: GAP 1's central opening verbatim: 'nobody treats safety-repair-induced task damage as a first-class quantity... the complementary task-restoring direction is sitting unused.' Also G2 (constrained optimal control through the sampler at inference: adjoint through the 10 Euler steps, controls priced against constraints, cross-chunk co-state propagation — none of which exists on frozen policies) and GAP 6 (restitution provably vanishes when repair does no damage, and is capped at the damage — never net task-forcing).
methods.math: Repaired dynamics: x_{k+1} = x_k + dtau (v_theta(x_k,tau_k) + r_k), where r_k is our sweep's exact repair. Task potential T(x_N) on the decoded chunk (destination/corridor progress of payload waypoints — value-free geometry, already in our stack). Lean adjoint: lambda_N = grad T(x_N); lambda_k = (I + dtau * grad_x v_theta(x_k,tau_k))^T lambda_{k+1} — one jax.vjp per step, 10 total, ~one extra backward-rollout per chunk on the winning seed. First-order repair damage: deltaT = sum_k dtau * lambda_{k+1}^T r_k (typically negative when repair strips task-directed velocity). Restitution control: u_k = c_k P_k lambda_k, where P_k = I - A_k^T(A_k A_k^T)^+ A_k projects onto the nullspace of the active barrier gradient rows A_k (the same rows the sweep computes; include near-active faces h <= eps_act). Safety neutrality (first order): d h_i / d c_k = grad h_i^T P_k lambda_k = 0 for all active i by construction; higher-order effects are irrelevant to the certificate because the exact sweep re-runs AFTER adding u_k — the forward-invariance theorem is a property of the sweep's output regardless of its input field, so the hard guarantee is preserved unconditionally. Restitution budget (the honesty device): choose {c_k >= 0} with per-step trust region c_k ||P_k lambda_k|| <= gamma to achieve sum_k dtau c_k lambda_k^T P_k lambda_k = min( max(0, -deltaT), beta ) — i.e., restore no more first-order task progress than the repair destroyed. Closed-form water-filling: since lambda_k^T P_k lambda_k = ||P_k lambda_k||^2 >= 0, allocate uniformly-scaled c_k = c* until the cap binds. Corollary 1 (vanishing): r_k = 0 for all k implies deltaT = 0 implies u = 0 — APNR reduces exactly to the baseline sampler when safety is inactive. Corollary 2 (bounded aggression): total first-order task push <= |deltaT|; APNR can never make the chunk more task-aggressive than the unrepaired policy intended. Cross-chunk co-state handoff: because observations drift slowly within a route, chunk n's co-states {lambda_k} warm-start chunk n+1 (lagged mode below), giving the first co-state propagation across chunk boundaries through executed-prefix conditioning.
methods.algorithm: Mode A (same-chunk, exact): (1) run the normal K-seed sampler; select winner; record its {x_k, r_k, A_k}. (2) One backward lean-adjoint pass (10 VJPs with jax.checkpoint per step) -> {lambda_k}, deltaT. (3) If deltaT >= 0 (repair helped or neutral): emit chunk unchanged. (4) Else compute {u_k} by the capped water-filling; re-integrate the winner's 10 steps with v_theta + u_k fed into the UNCHANGED exact sweep; emit. Cost: +1 rollout +1 adjoint on one seed (~30 NFE-equivalents). Mode B (lagged, zero serial latency): compute the adjoint of chunk n DURING execution of chunk n's committed prefix (RTC-compatible overlap); apply the resulting co-states as {u_k} in chunk n+1's generation directly (no re-rollout), with a staleness gate: if ||obs_{n+1} - obs_n|| exceeds a threshold or contact state changed, zero the co-states (honest degradation to baseline).
methods.joint_safety_task_story: This is the only place in the pipeline where safety and task interact as PRICED quantities: the co-state lambda_k is the exact first-order price of task progress at step k, and the repair r_k is the safety expenditure; APNR pays the task back precisely in the directions safety does not own (the nullspace), by exactly the audited amount. Safety is structurally incapable of being degraded (nullspace + sweep-last), and task is structurally incapable of being over-served (damage cap). Not a trade — a restitution: the certificate line 'safety >= spec, task damage from safety = 0 to first order' is a joint statement no accept/resample or override scheme can make.
methods.why_novel: Closest neighbors: (a) OC-Flow (ICLR'25) — PMP adjoint guidance at inference, but soft terminal reward only, no state constraints, no nullspace restriction, no feasibility/damage accounting, image generation not policies. (b) Adjoint Matching — the lean-adjoint machinery, but training-time fine-tuning under SDE assumptions; APNR reuses the machinery purely at inference on the frozen deterministic sampler. (c) DiRecT — per-denoise-step constrained optimization but an optimizer-in-the-loop state-trajectory planner with known geometry, not jittable, not a VLA. (d) Our claimed 'dual-dynamics multiplier-carried guidance strength' — carries CONSTRAINT multipliers to scale guidance; APNR propagates TASK co-states through the sampler Jacobian and confines the response to the constraint nullspace with a damage cap: different object, different guarantee. (e) Our claimed Riemannian metric min||d||_M — reshapes the repair itself; APNR acts after/orthogonally to any repair metric. No surveyed method computes an adjoint of a task potential through a frozen VLA's Euler steps, prices repair damage with it, or propagates co-states across chunk boundaries.
methods.failure_modes: First-order pricing is wrong under strong curvature of v_theta along the chunk (large dtau * Hessian): restitution may under/over-restore — the cap bounds over-restoration but not under-restoration; Mode A's re-rollout partially self-corrects. Adjoint cost: ~2x forward per VJP through a 3B net; Mode A adds ~30 NFE-equivalents per chunk (winner only) — apply only when total repair magnitude exceeds a trigger. Mode B staleness after contact events — gated to zero (honest). If the active set spans the action space, P_k = 0 and no restitution is possible: reported as 'task-unrestorable under active constraints', a truthful new failure telemetry rather than a silent trade. T's gradient can be misaligned with true task success on non-geometric subgoals (gripper timing) — restrict u_k to pose coordinates, leave gripper channel untouched.
methods.implementation_on_our_stack: Changes: (1) sampler returns per-step {x_k, r_k, active-row masks} for the winning seed (already computed inside the sweep; expose in the scan carry). (2) New jitted function adjoint_pass: jax.vjp of the per-step velocity fn under jax.checkpoint, scanned backward — no host calls. (3) New jitted function restitute: water-filling + re-rollout reusing the existing step fn (sweep last). (4) Mode B: co-state buffer in the cross-chunk carry + staleness gate on the observation embedding delta. T reuses the destination/corridor geometry module. Memory: per-step checkpointing keeps peak at ~1 forward's activations. Fully jittable; Mode B has zero added serial latency when overlapped with prefix execution.
methods.cost_days: 6-8 days: 2 days adjoint pass + finite-difference validation of co-states; 1 day water-filling + nullspace projection tests; 1-2 days Mode A integration + certificate telemetry; 1 day Mode B lagged variant; 1-2 days SafeLIBERO eval on repair-heavy cells.
methods.expected_gain: Directly targets TSR loss on high-CAR conditions where repair magnitude correlates with failure (the regime our Long L1 resurrection came from — expect further TSR gains on remaining repair-heavy cells at unchanged CAR, since CAR is sweep-owned). New telemetry ('task damage paid/restored per chunk') is itself a paper figure: the first quantified safety-tax accounting in the field.

methods.name: KBST: KL-Budgeted Source Transport with a Data-Processing Certificate
methods.one_liner: At each chunk boundary, transport the seed distribution N(0,I) by a closed-form affine map optimized against a joint safety-task surrogate regressed from our OWN K=8 seed-endpoint pairs, under a hard KL budget kappa — the data-processing inequality then certifies the executed action distribution stays within kappa nats of the frozen policy's, EVEN IF the surrogate is wrong.
methods.gap_it_fills: Theory G4 verbatim (certified online source-measure steering: transport of the source Gaussian from pullbacks of safety/task sets, with an explicit on-distribution guarantee — 'missing' per the survey). Also GAP 2 (cross-seed dispersion finally consumed as a directional signal, in source space), GAP 4 (online-adaptive epsilon-constraint arbitration: kappa tuned by realized executed-prefix margins), and the mode-selection failure that 2606.02884 proves gradient guidance cannot fix — KBST moves mass BETWEEN basins, complementing TECV's within-mode shaping.
methods.math: Let Psi_o be the frozen 10-step flow map at observation o, z ~ P = N(0, I_d) (d = H x 7 = 70). Transported source Q = N(b, C), affine. Certificate (unconditional): for any measurable map, KL(Psi_o # Q || Psi_o # P) <= KL(Q || P) = 0.5( tr C + b^T b - d - log det C ) <= kappa. This is the data-processing inequality; it does NOT depend on any model of Psi — so the harm bound (executed-chunk law within kappa nats of the frozen policy's law) survives arbitrary surrogate error. This is the first distributional honesty statement attached to any steering method in the survey (G1/G6). Surrogate: each chunk already yields K=8 pairs (z_j, x1_j); maintain a ring buffer over the last B chunks with observation-similarity decay weights; ridge-regress y_j = [h_min(x1_j), T(x1_j)] on z_j: beta_h, beta_T = (Z^T W Z + eta I)^{-1} Z^T W y — closed form, jittable, ZERO extra NFEs (uses samples we already pay for). Optional exact mode: beta = VJP of h∘Psi and T∘Psi at the incumbent seed (~20 NFE-equivalents per scalar) when the buffer is stale. Transport (epsilon-constraint): maximize E_Q[beta_T^T z] subject to Pr_Q[beta_h^T z + beta_h0 >= m] >= 1 - delta and KL(Q||P) <= kappa. With mean-shift-plus-rank-one-shrink C = I - rho u u^T (u = beta_h/||beta_h||), both the chance constraint (Gaussian: beta_h^T b + beta_h0 - Phi^{-1}(1-delta) sqrt(beta_h^T C beta_h) >= m) and KL are closed form; the optimum is a 2-variable problem (shift along span{beta_T, beta_h}, shrink rho) solved by a fixed small Newton/bisection — jittable. Unconstrained-safety case reduces to b* = sqrt(2 kappa) beta_T/||beta_T||. Feasibility: if no (b, rho) satisfies both constraints within kappa, KBST declares 'jointly unreachable under budget kappa' and reverts to P — an honest certified trigger (a weak, source-level version of G5's authority certificate). Online arbitration (GAP 4): kappa_{n+1} = clip( kappa_n + eta_up * 1[realized executed-prefix margins >= m_safe] - eta_dn * 1[margins < m_tight], 0, kappa_max ) — realized margins from the just-executed prefix, the natural feedback loop the survey notes nobody closes. Importance weights w_j = dP/dQ(z_j) (closed-form Gaussian ratio) let us report unbiased counterfactual baseline statistics for free (what the un-steered policy would have scored).
methods.algorithm: At each chunk boundary (jittable, no host calls): (1) push (z_j, h_min(x1_j), T(x1_j)) from the finished chunk into the ring buffer; decay weights by observation-embedding distance; hard-reset buffer on contact-state change. (2) Closed-form weighted ridge -> beta_h, beta_T. (3) Solve the 2-variable transport under current kappa_n; if infeasible -> Q = P and raise the fallback flag. (4) Draw the next chunk's K=8 seeds z ~ N(b, C) (reparametrized: z = b + L xi, L = chol(C), xi ~ N(0,I)); optionally k-means (fixed 2 clusters, fixed iterations) on buffered endpoints first and regress per-basin, transporting toward the better basin — certified soft mode commitment. (5) Run the unchanged downstream pipeline (Euler + sweep + best-of-K + certificate). (6) After executing the prefix, update kappa by the realized-margin controller. Everything downstream of seed drawing is untouched.
methods.joint_safety_task_story: The transport solves an explicit per-chunk epsilon-constraint program — maximize expected task progress subject to a probabilistic safety-margin floor — so safety and task are arbitrated in ONE optimization with an interpretable dial (kappa) that is itself closed-loop on realized safety margins: when the executed prefix shows comfortable margins, the budget grows and task steering strengthens; when margins tighten, the budget shrinks toward the native policy, and the hard sweep still backstops every step. Seeds are spent where safety AND task are jointly likely, so best-of-K stops wasting draws on seeds the sweep will mangle — task completion rises BECAUSE the safety machinery engages less, not despite it.
methods.why_novel: Closest neighbors, all distinct: (a) DSRL — noise-space steering but RL-TRAINED per deployment; KBST is zero-training, closed-form, per-chunk online. (b) Golden Ticket — one offline constant noise, state-independent, no measure, no certificate. (c) Start Right Arrive Right — flow inversion for a single consistency-targeted noise POINT; no distribution, no on-distribution guarantee (the survey explicitly flags this absence). (d) Ma et al. noise search / BOKBO / RoboMonkey-line — search or verifier selection over i.i.d. draws; KBST reshapes the sampling MEASURE with a divergence budget and keeps stochasticity. (e) Our claimed cross-chunk noise inheritance / FRS-informed seeds — inherit or bias particular seed points; KBST is measure-level transport whose defining novelty is the DPI harm bound and the closed-loop kappa arbitration, neither of which point-selection provides. (f) FKC/SMC — need weights/resampling and long chains. No surveyed method attaches a guarantee that holds independently of the steering signal's correctness; that unconditional harm bound is the core new object.
methods.failure_modes: Linear surrogate across basins averages gradients and can point nowhere useful — mitigated by per-basin regression, but with K=8 per chunk the fit is noisy early in the buffer (ridge + decay helps; first 1-2 chunks effectively run kappa ~ 0). The DPI bound is a HARM bound, not a benefit bound: KBST can legitimately do nothing (honest). kappa too large defeats the purpose of the certificate (kappa_max should be reported with results; we suggest kappa_max ~ 1-2 nats). Buffer staleness after abrupt scene changes — hard reset to P (baseline). The chance constraint uses the linear surrogate's Gaussian pushforward, so the margin floor is surrogate-level, not real; the real floor remains the sweep's (never claimed otherwise). Rank-one shrink assumes one dominant risk direction; multiple simultaneous hazards need rank-r shrink (straightforward, more eigen-work).
methods.implementation_on_our_stack: Changes: (1) seed-drawing site: replace z ~ N(0,I) with z = b + L xi (b, L from the transport solver in the chunk-boundary carry). (2) New jitted module: fixed-size ring buffer (device array), weighted ridge (closed form), 2-variable transport solver (fixed-iteration bisection/Newton), kappa controller — all static shapes, no host calls; fits inside the existing chunk-boundary jitted region. (3) Certificate logging: kappa_n, KL used, feasibility flag, importance-weighted counterfactuals appended to the existing lexicographic certificate record. (4) Optional exact-beta mode: jax.vjp through the existing rollout scan (reuses APNR's adjoint plumbing if both ship). No change to the Euler loop, sweep, or fallback.
methods.cost_days: 3-5 days: 1 day buffer + ridge + unit tests on synthetic flows; 1 day transport solver + KL/chance-constraint tests; 1 day integration + kappa controller; 1-2 days SafeLIBERO eval (seed-yield and TSR vs kappa sweep).
methods.expected_gain: Higher fraction of the K=8 seeds that are jointly feasible (measurable as seed yield), translating to TSR gains on multimodal/route-choice conditions where i.i.d. seeds waste draws on doomed modes — precisely the failure class within-mode guidance (TECV) and repair (sweep/APNR) cannot address. The kappa-vs-(TSR, CAR) sweep gives the field's first certified, tunable safety-task Pareto curve at inference (GAP 4), a headline paper figure; the DPI harm bound is the first unconditional distributional statement for any VLA steering method (G1/G6).
